profile.headline: Software Engineer and Human Router
profile.summary:
Software Engineer with emphasis on data and backend services.

Whether it is people, applications or data, I am about connecting. You can see this in my work and in the organizations I am part of outside of work.
https://krysflores.com/

**Please note that I only accept invitations to people I know IRL or through online communities. However, I am open to communication via the Inbox should you have any questions and think I can help :)

positions.title: Staff Software Engineer
positions.description: Fractional Staff+ Engineer focusing on AI projects.

positions.title: Staff Engineer
positions.description:
[Written by ChatGPT v4.0 and edited by me.]

I'm proud to be the first internally promoted 🚀 Staff Engineer, a testament to the company's commitment to nurturing talent and being given the opportunity to grow, innovate, and contribute to some incredible projects.

I have honed my skills in distributed systems, software architecture, and cloud technologies while also developing a deep understanding of the business domain. I've worked with technologies like Node.js, TypeScript, Python, RESTful APIs, microservices, a monolith, AWS, and Docker, along with agile methodologies and DevOps practices.

Some notable projects:

- 🚀 Webhooks: Classic build v. buy decision. I decided to "buy". We successfully integrated with Svix. 
- 🎯 Campaigns: Imagine being able to send a marketing campaign for a million printed mail pieces with five requests instead of one million requests. Or no requests because we have a UI for that and you don't need a dev team?
- 🛠️ Custom Mail Builder: V1 to V2 of the our print mail platform. 
- 🎨 Creative Dedupe : Reducing redundancy and significantly improving performance in digital asset management for mail pieces.
- 🏰 Guardian of the Monolith (and other services): Played a critical role in maintaining and improving the monolithic architecture, ensuring the application's stability, scalability, and security.
- 🔄 Shared Local Services: Developed shared local services to standardize and streamline the utilization of common functionalities across multiple applications.

Awards:
- The Engineering Team’s Annual Award for Excellence, Print and Mail API Team, Dec 2022

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Our systems hyper-scaled from 5K customers to 200K in a few months, so I re-architected and refactored our notification services for the new scale. 
 -- Service based architecture that could process both single and batch jobs, e.g. communications service and loans service.
 -- Too much logic existed on the client side (React), so I began to move it to the server side (Python and Node.js, AWS).
- Integrated with Lob HTTP API to automate sending physical mail; replaced the daily manual printing and mailing of hundreds of compliance letters.
- To test loan-related APIs that could pass our stringent FinTech needs, I built the team’s testing framework to generate and break down fake customers, loans, transactions and associations in MSSQL.

COVID layoffs

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Designed and implemented search solution using MongoDB as a first step in better content discovery within the app; this was also an attempt to move more code logic from the frontend to the backend (previous search was a series of IF statements using RegEx in Swift).
-- I spoke at MongoDB World 2019 about this project.
- Coordinated and executed API contracts for 5.0 version of the app, including complete module redesign; this was the second milestone for increasing content discovery within the app.
- Created React/Keystone.js/Node.js/MongoDB fullstack administrative tools for the Content teams to enable them to change content within the app at the press of a button; it previously took an entire sprint for an engineer to move content for the Content team.
- Championed and implemented processes for faster, cleaner scaling of the codebase. This included moving to async/await, creating extensive testing frameworks, enabling an auto-save linter, and setting-up pre-commit hooks.


Startup life. Layoffs happen.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Led project to move our contractor code internally; previously, 3 contractors worked on the code every week; my integrations enabled one internal team member to spend one day a week on it; in the process, I figured out the entire lifecycle for newsletter opt outs to ensure compatibility with CA Privacy Act; Python, AWS, Redshift
- Awards: 1st Place, Nordstrom "Fanatic Service" Hackathon (1/26 teams); NRHL Initiative Award

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Deployed, managed, updated and queried big data infrastructure, which included terabytes of data from partners
- Produced client facing data products using a mix of Python, JavaScript, Redshift, MongoDB, SQL, and Java
- Wrote internal and external developer documentation for batch files and SDK

positions.title: Founder and Principal Consultant
positions.description:
- Product manager consultant for clients looking to improve user/customer experiences via building/designing apps or teams.
- Interviewed users, created user stories, developed clickable prototypes, user-tested, and conducted business analysis for industries including interior design, entertainment and education. 
- Most recent case study: In 60 days and 20% the industry budget, I designed, recruited and built a team and system for customer support which integrated web/mobile apps, Zendesk, automation, emails and socials to handle 12,335 questions average per month (60x the industry average) while increasing customer satisfaction rating 30%.

positions.title: Product Manager and Assistant Head Counselor
positions.description:
- Wireframed, designed front-end, and shipped company’s internal web app focusing on counselors, teachers, administrators, students and parents as users with the main goal to improve counselor productivity; resulted in  20% increase in counselor efficiency (savings of $320K annually at current growth); total budget was $40K, less than $100K originally budgeted.
- Managed 75 students' strategic college plan (average caseload was 40).
